notes: Chapel preparation is faster to use: bigger tap targets, status labels, a next-task button and a more compact date and Ordo card.
new: Next task button and a "tasks left" count, plus a Hide done option.
Every task shows a Done, To do or Locked label, and the whole card is easy to tap.
Chapel now has its own tab in the bottom bar, with one set of outline icons.
The Ordo card shows the celebration and color, with readings and notes tucked into expandable sections.
The date bar is more compact and has a Back to Today shortcut.
changed: Updates moved from the bottom bar to Settings, with a red dot on Settings when a new version is ready.
Completed tasks are easier to read, with a thin line instead of a heavy strikethrough.
The Mass and Feast day controls now wrap neatly on narrow screens.
